facts.P1_fx_receipts: Possible, but foreign currency is scarce and official rates differ from market rates.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes, but getting dollars out can be slow when reserves are short.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways not confirmed yet; see the services listed above.
facts.L1_registration: Register with the Office of the Administrator and Registrar General (OARG), mostly in person.
facts.L2_tax_id: TIN from the National Revenue Authority, using your National Identification Number.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Not confirmed; sole proprietors reportedly pay 15–30% on profits.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 15% GST; domestic threshold and export rules not confirmed.
facts.L5_data_protection: No data protection law yet; a bill is in progress.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: No online consumer protection law recorded in UNCTAD's tracker.
